description:
The Bible offers guidance on wearing jewelry, focusing on modesty and the importance of inner beauty. Join Pastor Lomacang and John Dinzey as they explore this topic and many others, shedding light on biblical principles for everyday life.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1. Can you please explain what is meant by offering up Spiritual Sacrifices as mentioned in 1 Peter 2:5?  Can you please explain Spiritual Sacrifices as mentioned in 1 Peter 2:5?

2. Pastor Lomacang, on a previous program you talked about wearing jewelry saying it was part of how the Egyptians used it to guide their soul from being taken by an evil sprite. What does it mean for this generation? Please help me understand. What's wrong with wearing jewelry?

3. When Jesus spoke about sin, for example, adultery, He mentioned that even thinking about adultery is sin. Is he implying that it is impossible for us humans to not sin? If so, why did He tell the woman who was to be stoned, you are forgiven go forth and sin no more? Is He implying that the woman is dead? Does Jesus think it's impossible for humans not to sin?

4. In the Great Controversy, I know that Satan took 1/3 of the angels with him when he was cast out of Heaven. The angels that were cast out with him were deceived by him, is it possible they can repent, and have acceptance back into Heaven in the end times? Can the angels that were cast out of Heaven repent?

5. How do we know Stephen was stoned in 34 AD? 

6. My family member tells me and others that we are going to hell if we don't go to church on Saturday. I read Colossians 2:16 and have been standing on that verse. Is my family correct? Can you please explain Colossians 2:16?
 
7. How could the Devil enter the snake in the Garden of Eden, but the demons couldn’t go into the pigs without permission? How did Satan get permission to enter the serpent? 

8.  What does "a house divided cannot stand" mean? 

9. When is it necessary to be re-baptized?

10. Why does Jesus love us even though we don't always do the right things?
